title: Choo-choo train, Claude Haiku in one call (the benchmark's own way)
model: Claude Haiku 5.5 through Anthropic's API: one call with MineBench's prompt, no tools, no second try
verdict: Compact and coherent: a black locomotive with a curling smoke plume, a gold bell and a cab, a tender, two red passenger cars with windows and a yellow stripe, a platform with a canopy, trees. Everything sits on the track (3 tiny floating pieces). Fewer blocks than purple Skippy's v1, but the best composition: every part where it belongs.
